sources.finding: Apache-2.0 repository notice. Applies to rights the licensor can grant; it does not replace embedded Wikipedia terms.
Release 20210407 contains Wikipedia paragraphs, titles and sentence/hyperlink locators.
MuSiQue is distributed under CC BY 4.0. Seed sources include SQuAD, T-REx, Natural Questions, MLQA and Zero Shot RE.
Section 7 requires attribution and applicable licenses, identifies exceptions for fair-use content and additional attribution, and requires ShareAlike and change notices for adapted community text.
Official dataset page identifies CC BY-SA 4.0.
Official data download page identifies Creative Commons Share-Alike 3.0, separately from the code repository license.
Official README distinguishes dataset CC BY-SA 3.0 from the code license.
Official project page identifies dataset CC BY-SA 4.0 and extraction pipeline MIT.
Attribution, a license reference and indication of modifications are required. The grant only covers rights the licensor can license.
Adapted material has attribution and ShareAlike conditions; mere inclusion in a collection does not automatically impose its license on unrelated independent code.
API terms effective April 29, 2026 assign any provider rights in outputs to the user subject to law and terms; input/third-party rights remain separate.
Inputs/outputs remain the user responsibility; third-party output material is not guaranteed non-infringing.
Official Qwen3-8B model license is Apache-2.0. No model weights are included here; this is not a blanket license for copied prompt passages.
